title: Anti-Sterlite protests: CM orders ₹5.25-cr. additional relief to victims

ai.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister ordered additional ₹5.25 crore relief for families affected by 2018 anti-Sterlite protests, where 13 died and 40 were grievously injured in police firing.

facts.claim: 13 people lost their lives (in police firing)
facts.quote: 13 people lost their lives (in police firing)
ordered disbursement of an additional ₹5.25 crore as relief to the families affected during the anti-Sterlite protest in Thoothukudi in 2018

facts.claim: Families had already received ₹25 lakh each for 13 deceased
facts.quote: Their families had already been provided relief of ₹25 lakh each for the 13 deceased

facts.claim: Families had already received ₹5 lakh each for 40 grievously injured
facts.quote: Their families had already been provided relief of ₹5 lakh each for the 40 grievously injured

facts.claim: Total compensation per grievously injured person is ₹10 lakh
facts.quote: The total compensation per person who was grievously injured amounts to ₹10 lakh

ai.background_note: The 2018 anti-Sterlite protest in Thoothukudi led to 13 deaths and 40 grievous injuries, prompting a compensation order from the Chief Minister.
